02 · Things only I would know

My favourite little pieces of you.

The big things are easy to remember. I wanted to keep the tiny, ridiculous, very-you things too.

🎶 Mariah the Scientist.Your favourite singer. If a song comes on, there is a very good chance I am thinking of you.
🧼 The bleach hands.You are always cleaning something, so somehow your hands constantly smell like bleach. I swear even that became part of “you” in my head.
🍤 Absolutely no seafood.Not “maybe.” Not “I'll try it.” Seafood is simply not invited.
🏠 Going out? Hard pass.You would honestly choose being comfortable at home over going out most days — and somehow I love that about you.
📅 And about our anniversary…You keep saying the 8th. I know it's the 25th. 😭❤️ I am never letting you forget that one.
🎬 The first secret mission.The first time you came to me, we told your parents we went to the movies. We both know that was a lie. Our little secret forever.

05 · From me to you

Happy Birthday, my love.

Tumeeshu, I wish I could put every laugh, every look, every random conversation, every tiny moment that made me smile because of you into this one page.

Thank you for being the person you are. Thank you for the moments that became memories without us even realising it. And thank you for making ordinary days feel a little less ordinary.

I love the little things about you too — the way Mariah the Scientist somehow belongs in the soundtrack of us, the fact that you are always cleaning until your hands smell like bleach, your complete refusal to entertain seafood, and the fact that your perfect night is probably staying in rather than going out.

And yes… I know you think our anniversary is the 8th. I know the truth: it's the 25th. 😂❤️ I will happily carry that fact for both of us.

And I'll never forget our first little secret either — telling your parents we were going to the movies when we both knew that wasn't the whole story. Maybe that wasn't the most innocent beginning, but it became one of my favourite memories.

I hope this next year gives you reasons to smile when nobody is watching, adventures you never saw coming, peace when you need it, and people around you who remind you just how incredible you are.

And if I get to make one wish for us, it's this:

I can't wait to make more memories with you. ❤️

Always yours.
